_contract.purpose: Explicit allowlist for the T00 mandatory no-skip gate (policy A, owner-approved 2026-09-12).
semantics: A real pytest.skip()/pytest.importorskip() call inside a mandatory T* test file is accepted ONLY when (a) the file source is OS-conditional ('platform.system' present — unchanged rule), or (b) ALL of the following hold: the file is listed in 'entries'; the call's statically-extractable reason text contains at least one of the entry's 'reason_patterns'; and the file source still contains the entry's 'env_guard_token'.

Everything else still FAILS (fail-closed): undeclared files, undeclared reasons, missing env guards, stale entries (allowlisted file with no real skip call), missing/malformed/marginally-valid contracts.
pytestmark whole-file skips and decorator skips (skip/xfail/skipif) are NEVER allowlisted here.
The gate prints a 'declared_infra_skips:' summary for every green run so declared skips are never silent.
_contract.review_rule: Adding, changing or removing an entry is a deliberate, reviewed contract change: edit this file AND update the pin test test_declared_infra_skip_allowlist_pins_known_files in tests/T00_integrity/test_meta_audit.py. No wildcards: each entry names exactly one file and only the reason patterns actually present in that file.

Trước đây là decorator skipif(/.dockerenv) (vi phạm no-skip gate); chuyển sang policy A với strictness TĂNG: phần 1-2 hermetic luôn chạy, chỉ phần 3 warehouse mới được skip có khai báo.
